title: 01 院前预警：先准备接手
01 Pre-alert: prepare to receive
info: 32岁男性，系安全带驾驶员，车辆侧向撞击；伤后约25分钟。主诉胸痛、气促和左大腿痛。短暂意识不清由目击者报告，持续时间不详。
A 32-year-old restrained male driver after a side-impact collision, about 25 min after injury. Chest pain, dyspnoea and left-thigh pain. Witnesses report brief unresponsiveness of uncertain duration.
unknown: 失血来源、气道污染、胸膜腔损伤、抗凝药和完整病史未明。
Bleeding source, airway contamination, pleural injury, anticoagulants and full history remain unknown.
priority: 按xABCDE分工；准备出血、气道、呼吸与循环资源并行接手。
Assign xABCDE roles; prepare parallel haemorrhage, airway, breathing and circulation resources.
reassess: 到院重新测量，核对氧疗方式、变化及院前措施效果。
Repeat measurements on arrival; verify oxygen delivery, changes and response to prehospital care.

oxygen: 空气；随后开始吸氧，现场流量未记录
Room air; oxygen then started, field flow not documented

question: 到院前如何同时准备？
How should pre-arrival preparation be organized?
good: 保留全身威胁，团队并行准备并核对未知信息。
Retain whole-body threats, prepare in parallel and clarify unknowns.
bad: 单病种准备可能遗漏其他立即威胁。
Single-injury preparation can miss other immediate threats.

label: 按xABCDE分工、预警血库与胸部救援
Assign xABCDE roles, alert blood bank and thoracic rescue
feedback: 高能量机制与多轴症状要求并行准备。
High-energy mechanism and multiple-axis symptoms require parallel readiness.

label: 只预约胸部CT
Book chest CT alone
feedback: 该选择会遗漏当前风险：高能量机制与多轴症状要求并行准备。
This misses current risk: High-energy mechanism and multiple-axis symptoms require parallel readiness.

label: 只为左大腿骨折准备固定
Prepare only for the femoral injury
feedback: 该选择会遗漏当前风险：高能量机制与多轴症状要求并行准备。
This misses current risk: High-energy mechanism and multiple-axis symptoms require parallel readiness.

title: 02 接车交接：病史与院前措施
02 Handoff: history and prehospital care
info: 院前实施气道观察、吸氧、左大腿伤口加压敷料、肢体临时固定、脊柱保护、保暖、静脉通路及快速转运；未报告胸腔减压或输血。到院胸痛7/10，说短句、皮肤湿冷。过敏、既往病史、末次进食及药物尚待补全。

Prehospital airway observation, oxygen, pressure dressing over the left-thigh wound, temporary limb immobilisation, spinal precautions, warmth, IV access and prompt transfer. No chest decompression or blood transfusion reported. Arrival: chest pain 7/10, short phrases and cool clammy skin. Allergies, past history, last meal and medications still require clarification.
unknown: 不能因已处理伤口就断定止血充分，亦未确认休克机制。
A treated wound does not establish adequate haemorrhage control; shock mechanism is not yet established.
priority: 实习：计算并报告SI/ABC、请求MTP；规培：监督下准备TXA 1 g静脉输注≥10 min+1 g/8 h、骨盆带大转子水平与EFAST；主治：启动MTP、协调手术/介入。以本院规范为准。

Intern: report SI/ABC and request MTP; resident: supervised TXA preparation (1 g IV over at least ten minutes then 1 g/eight hours), binder at greater trochanters and EFAST; attending: activate MTP and coordinate surgery/intervention. Follow institutional policy.
reassess: 同一初评时间点，后续x/A/B/C/D/E卡不代表等待数分钟。
The following x/A/B/C/D/E cards share one survey time; they do not imply waiting minutes.

time: 伤后25 min · 到院0 min并行初评
25 min after injury · arrival primary survey
oxygen: 初始面罩6 L/min不足：改储氧面罩15 L/min，目标94–98%；以本院规范为准。
Initial 6 L/min mask oxygen is inadequate: reservoir mask 15 L/min, target 94–98%; follow institutional policy.

question: 此刻应启动什么？
What should be activated now?
good: 高能量多发伤伴呼吸受损与灌注不足，机制仍需并行判断。
High-energy polytrauma with respiratory impairment and poor perfusion; mechanisms need parallel assessment.
bad: 只复述诊断名称会漏掉变化与未解问题。
Repeating a diagnostic label alone misses changes and unresolved questions.
labs: 乳酸4.8 mmol/L；SI=126/88≈1.43；ABC心率/血压两项使评分至少2。
Lactate 4.8 mmol/L; SI=126/88 about 1.43; HR/BP give at least two ABC points.

label: 启动MTP评估、TXA与止血资源并行
Activate MTP assessment, TXA and hemorrhage-control resources
feedback: HR/SBP两项ABC已至少2，伤后25 min在TXA时间窗内。
Two ABC criteria are present; at25 minutes the TXA window is open.

label: 先全身CT后联系血库
Whole-body CT before blood-bank contact
feedback: 该选择会遗漏当前风险：HR/SBP两项ABC已至少2，伤后25 min在TXA时间窗内。
This misses current risk: Two ABC criteria are present; at25 minutes the TXA window is open.

label: 先大量晶体液等Hb下降再输血
Large crystalloid volume while waiting for hemoglobin to fall
feedback: 该选择会遗漏当前风险：HR/SBP两项ABC已至少2，伤后25 min在TXA时间窗内。
This misses current risk: Two ABC criteria are present; at25 minutes the TXA window is open.

title: 03 x + A：外出血与气道
03 x + A: bleeding and airway
info: x：左大腿敷料有血迹，交接后未见快速扩大；未测失血量。A：可说短句，无明显喉鸣，口内少量血性唾液；需持续确认气道通畅与保护。保持团队颈椎保护。

x: blood on the left-thigh dressing, without rapid expansion during handoff; blood loss unmeasured. A: short phrases, no obvious stridor and a little blood-stained saliva; airway patency and protection require continuing assessment. Maintain team spinal precautions.
unknown: 敷料外观不等于总失血量；能说话不等于气道风险已经关闭。
Dressing appearance does not quantify total blood loss; speech does not close airway risk.
priority: 实习：计算并报告SI/ABC、请求MTP；规培：监督下准备TXA 1 g静脉输注≥10 min+1 g/8 h、骨盆带大转子水平与EFAST；主治：启动MTP、协调手术/介入。以本院规范为准。

Intern: report SI/ABC and request MTP; resident: supervised TXA preparation (1 g IV over at least ten minutes then 1 g/eight hours), binder at greater trochanters and EFAST; attending: activate MTP and coordinate surgery/intervention. Follow institutional policy.
reassess: 看敷料是否继续变化、声音/分泌物/意识是否改变。
Compare dressing changes, voice, secretions and consciousness.

time: 伤后25 min · 到院0 min并行初评
25 min after injury · arrival primary survey
oxygen: 储氧面罩15 L/min，目标SpO₂94–98%；以本院规范为准。
Reservoir mask 15 L/min, target SpO2 94–98%; follow institutional policy.

question: 可说短句但口内有血，A如何处理？
He speaks short phrases but has blood in the mouth. Airway action?
good: 不能；持续复评并将新变化立即报告。
No; continue reassessment and report new changes immediately.
bad: 一次观察不能排除随后恶化。
One observation cannot exclude later deterioration.
labs: 乳酸4.8 mmol/L；SI=126/88≈1.43；ABC心率/血压两项使评分至少2。
Lactate 4.8 mmol/L; SI=126/88 about 1.43; HR/BP give at least two ABC points.

label: 吸引清理、复评保护能力、保持SMR并准备失败救援
Suction, reassess protection, maintain SMR and prepare rescue
feedback: 说话提供信息，污染和后续意识变化仍需观察。
Speech is informative but contamination and consciousness change still require surveillance.

label: 说话即判气道安全，不再观察
Treat speech as proof of a safe airway
feedback: 该选择会遗漏当前风险：说话提供信息，污染和后续意识变化仍需观察。
This misses current risk: Speech is informative but contamination and consciousness change still require surveillance.

label: 先撤保护做完整口咽检查再报告
Remove protection for a full oral examination before reporting
feedback: 该选择会遗漏当前风险：说话提供信息，污染和后续意识变化仍需观察。
This misses current risk: Speech is informative but contamination and consciousness change still require surveillance.

title: 04 B：呼吸与胸部威胁
04 B: breathing and chest threats
info: 右胸局部压痛、起伏减弱，右侧呼吸音较左低；辅助呼吸肌参与。仍需同时考虑胸壁疼痛、肺损伤及气胸/血胸，不能仅凭这些资料诊断张力生理。

Right-sided tenderness, reduced chest excursion and quieter breath sounds; accessory muscles are active. Consider chest-wall pain, lung injury and pneumothorax/haemothorax together; these findings alone do not establish tension physiology.
unknown: 床旁影像尚未回报；氧合不反映全部通气状态。
Bedside imaging is not yet available; oxygenation does not describe ventilation fully.
priority: 实习：计算并报告SI/ABC、请求MTP；规培：监督下准备TXA 1 g静脉输注≥10 min+1 g/8 h、骨盆带大转子水平与EFAST；主治：启动MTP、协调手术/介入。以本院规范为准。

Intern: report SI/ABC and request MTP; resident: supervised TXA preparation (1 g IV over at least ten minutes then 1 g/eight hours), binder at greater trochanters and EFAST; attending: activate MTP and coordinate surgery/intervention. Follow institutional policy.
reassess: RR、深度、说话、氧疗需求、SpO₂和意识一起比较。
Compare RR, depth, speech, oxygen requirement, SpO₂ and consciousness.

time: 伤后25 min · 到院0 min并行初评
25 min after injury · arrival primary survey
oxygen: 储氧面罩15 L/min，目标SpO₂94–98%；以本院规范为准。
Reservoir mask 15 L/min, target SpO2 94–98%; follow institutional policy.

question: 休克伴单侧呼吸音弱、持续低氧，先做什么？
Shock, unilateral quiet breath sounds and persistent hypoxia: first?
good: 先结合生理处理立即威胁，床旁信息与复苏并行。
Address immediate threats using physiology; bedside information and resuscitation proceed together.
bad: 把CT当先决条件可能延误团队处理。
Making CT a prerequisite can delay team care.
labs: 乳酸4.8 mmol/L；SI=126/88≈1.43；ABC心率/血压两项使评分至少2。
Lactate 4.8 mmol/L; SI=126/88 about 1.43; HR/BP give at least two ABC points.

label: 床旁立即评估张力/血胸并按资质救援
Immediately assess tension/hemothorax and provide skilled rescue
feedback: 严重呼吸/循环损害下疑张力不能为影像延迟。
Suspected tension with severe respiratory/circulatory compromise must not wait for imaging.

label: 等增强CT确诊才减压
Await contrast CT before decompression
feedback: 该选择会遗漏当前风险：严重呼吸/循环损害下疑张力不能为影像延迟。
This misses current risk: Suspected tension with severe respiratory/circulatory compromise must not wait for imaging.

label: 只重复测一次SpO₂
Repeat saturation alone
feedback: 该选择会遗漏当前风险：严重呼吸/循环损害下疑张力不能为影像延迟。
This misses current risk: Suspected tension with severe respiratory/circulatory compromise must not wait for imaging.

title: 05 C：休克机制与早期检验
05 C: shock mechanisms and early tests
info: 脉搏快弱，毛细血管再充盈约4秒，四肢湿冷；左大腿肿胀并有伤口，腹部轻压痛。出血性休克高度担心，同时保留胸部阻塞性因素；尚未确认唯一来源。

Rapid weak pulse, capillary refill about 4 s and cool clammy limbs; swollen wounded left thigh and mild abdominal tenderness. Haemorrhagic shock is a major concern; retain obstructive chest causes without assigning one proven source.
unknown: 未有定量尿量或确定出血源；早期Hb不能单独排除大量失血。
No quantified urine output or confirmed bleeding source; early Hb cannot alone exclude major blood loss.
priority: 实习：计算并报告SI/ABC、请求MTP；规培：监督下准备TXA 1 g静脉输注≥10 min+1 g/8 h、骨盆带大转子水平与EFAST；主治：启动MTP、协调手术/介入。以本院规范为准。

Intern: report SI/ABC and request MTP; resident: supervised TXA preparation (1 g IV over at least ten minutes then 1 g/eight hours), binder at greater trochanters and EFAST; attending: activate MTP and coordinate surgery/intervention. Follow institutional policy.
reassess: 灌注、意识、BP趋势和乳酸后续变化一起复评。
Reassess perfusion, consciousness, BP trends and subsequent lactate change together.

time: 伤后25 min · 到院0 min并行初评
25 min after injury · arrival primary survey
oxygen: 储氧面罩15 L/min，目标SpO₂94–98%；以本院规范为准。
Reservoir mask 15 L/min, target SpO2 94–98%; follow institutional policy.

question: FAST阴性但SBP88，怎样继续C？
FAST is negative but SBP88 persists. Circulation plan?
good: 不能，必须放回机制、体征和连续趋势。
No; interpret it with mechanism, examination and serial trends.
bad: 把单项Hb当止血证明会造成锚定。
Treating one Hb value as proof of haemostasis causes anchoring.
labs: 乳酸4.8 mmol/L；SI=126/88≈1.43；ABC心率/血压两项使评分至少2。
Lactate 4.8 mmol/L; SI=126/88 about 1.43; HR/BP give at least two ABC points.

label: 继续MTP与隐匿出血源评估、协调止血
Continue MTP/occult-source assessment and coordinate control
feedback: 阴性FAST不排除骨盆/腹膜后出血。
Negative FAST does not exclude pelvic/retroperitoneal bleeding.

label: 阴性FAST后停止寻找腹膜后来源
Stop searching retroperitoneum after negative FAST
feedback: 该选择会遗漏当前风险：阴性FAST不排除骨盆/腹膜后出血。
This misses current risk: Negative FAST does not exclude pelvic/retroperitoneal bleeding.

label: 仅按肢体创口解释全部休克
Attribute all shock to the limb wound
feedback: 该选择会遗漏当前风险：阴性FAST不排除骨盆/腹膜后出血。
This misses current risk: Negative FAST does not exclude pelvic/retroperitoneal bleeding.

title: 06 D + E：神经、遗漏损伤与环境
06 D + E: neurology, missed injury and environment
info: GCS14（E4V4M6），瞳孔等大约3 mm、对光反应存在；四肢可按指令活动但左腿受疼痛限制。暴露检查发现腹部安全带痕与左大腿伤；持续保暖和隐私保护。未反复挤压骨盆以诱发不稳。 安全带征伴低血压需警惕空腔脏器伤及Chance型屈曲牵张伤；先床旁FAST/胸片，复苏有反应且允许时CT，不稳定无反应直接止血。

GCS 14 (E4V4M6), equal approximately 3-mm reactive pupils; obeys limb commands, left-leg movement limited by pain. Exposure reveals an abdominal seat-belt mark and left-thigh injury. Maintain warmth and privacy; do not repeatedly compress the pelvis to provoke instability. A seatbelt mark with hypotension raises concern for hollow-viscus and Chance flexion-distraction injuries; use bedside FAST/chest X-ray, CT only when physiology allows, and direct control for an unstable nonresponder.
unknown: 意识改变可能涉及头伤、低灌注或低氧；瞳孔正常不排除颅内损伤。
Altered consciousness may involve head injury, poor perfusion or hypoxia; normal pupils do not exclude intracranial injury.
priority: 实习：计算并报告SI/ABC、请求MTP；规培：监督下准备TXA 1 g静脉输注≥10 min+1 g/8 h、骨盆带大转子水平与EFAST；主治：启动MTP、协调手术/介入。以本院规范为准。

Intern: report SI/ABC and request MTP; resident: supervised TXA preparation (1 g IV over at least ten minutes then 1 g/eight hours), binder at greater trochanters and EFAST; attending: activate MTP and coordinate surgery/intervention. Follow institutional policy.
reassess: GCS分项、瞳孔、运动和体温与前次比较。
Compare GCS components, pupils, movement and temperature with prior observations.

time: 伤后25 min · 到院0 min并行初评
25 min after injury · arrival primary survey
oxygen: 储氧面罩15 L/min，目标SpO₂94–98%；以本院规范为准。
Reservoir mask 15 L/min, target SpO2 94–98%; follow institutional policy.

question: 安全带痕、新神经变化和低温，需要哪组任务？
Seatbelt mark, neurological change and low temperature: tasks?
good: 不应；教学顺序不等于临床等待顺序。
No; teaching order is not a clinical waiting sequence.
bad: 任何立即威胁都需及时团队处理。
Any immediate threat requires timely team attention.
labs: 乳酸4.8 mmol/L；SI=126/88≈1.43；ABC心率/血压两项使评分至少2。
Lactate 4.8 mmol/L; SI=126/88 about 1.43; HR/BP give at least two ABC points.

label: 并行SMR、神经复评、保暖与腹部/脊柱相关伤检查
Parallel SMR, neurological review, warming and associated-injury assessment
feedback: 新线索立即改变任务，查体不应加重低温。
New findings alter tasks immediately; examination should not worsen hypothermia.

label: 等待所有卡片完成再报告新发现
Wait until all cards are complete to report
feedback: 该选择会遗漏当前风险：新线索立即改变任务，查体不应加重低温。
This misses current risk: New findings alter tasks immediately; examination should not worsen hypothermia.

label: 先放弃保暖以完成全部暴露
Stop warming to finish full exposure
feedback: 该选择会遗漏当前风险：新线索立即改变任务，查体不应加重低温。
This misses current risk: New findings alter tasks immediately; examination should not worsen hypothermia.

title: 07 8分钟复评：氧合改善，灌注未解决
07 Reassessment at 8 min: oxygenation better, perfusion unresolved
info: 已升级储氧面罩并复核出血、气道、胸部；MTP评估及止血团队联络已启动。氧合改善但BP88/56、HR126、乳酸4.8仍提示灌注问题；复评不是结束。

Reservoir oxygen and bleeding/airway/chest reassessment are in place; MTP assessment and hemorrhage-control coordination have started. Better oxygenation does not resolve BP88/56, HR126 and lactate4.8 perfusion concern.
unknown: 不能用SpO₂改善宣布稳定；出血源、胸部原因和乳酸趋势仍待明确。
Improved SpO₂ does not establish stability; bleeding source, chest causes and lactate trend remain unresolved.
priority: 实习：计算并报告SI/ABC、请求MTP；规培：监督下准备TXA 1 g静脉输注≥10 min+1 g/8 h、骨盆带大转子水平与EFAST；主治：启动MTP、协调手术/介入。以本院规范为准。

Intern: report SI/ABC and request MTP; resident: supervised TXA preparation (1 g IV over at least ten minutes then 1 g/eight hours), binder at greater trochanters and EFAST; attending: activate MTP and coordinate surgery/intervention. Follow institutional policy.
reassess: 这是预设观察记录；选择题不改变这些数值，不模拟治疗的必然效果。
This is a scripted observation; quiz choices do not change these values or imply a guaranteed treatment effect.

time: 伤后33 min · 到院8 min复评
33 min after injury · arrival +8 min reassessment
oxygen: 储氧面罩15 L/min，目标SpO₂94–98%；以本院规范为准。

question: SpO₂改善但灌注未解决，接下来？
Oxygenation improves but perfusion is unresolved. Next?
good: 不能，持续处理未解风险并比较趋势。
No; continue addressing unresolved risks and comparing trends.
bad: 单一指标改善不能代表整体恢复。
One improved variable does not establish overall recovery.
labs: 乳酸4.8 mmol/L；SI=126/88≈1.43；ABC心率/血压两项使评分至少2。
Lactate 4.8 mmol/L; SI=126/88 about 1.43; HR/BP give at least two ABC points.

End resuscitation and move to an ordinary waiting area

Keep adjusting the mask instead of addressing circulation
feedback: 该选择会遗漏当前风险：单一氧合改善不等于休克解决。
This misses current risk: Improved oxygenation alone does not resolve shock.
